cim: Drake professors to host two generative AI events in December
cim_eredeti: Drake professors to host two generative AI events in December
szoveg_eredeti:
Drake University professors Chris Porter and Chris Snider will host two virtual events in December to help individuals and businesses stay informed about the rapidly evolving world of generative artificial intelligence and develop practical skills for using AI in the workplace.

The events, offered through Innovation Profs and Drake’s School of Journalism and Mass Communication, include a free overview of recent developments in generative AI and a three-hour, hands-on workshop focused on Microsoft Copilot.

Wednesday, Dec. 9, noon to 1 p.m. Central time

Porter and Snider will host their fourth annual holiday-themed generative AI update, highlighting the most significant developments in artificial intelligence over the past four months.

The virtual event will explore the continuing evolution of AI tools, including new models, AI agents and more. Attendees will gain a better understanding of the current AI landscape and what to watch for heading into 2027.

The event is designed for both newcomers to generative AI and experienced users looking to stay current with the latest developments.

The event is free and open to the public thanks to a sponsorship from technology and management consultancy Lean TECHniques.

Tuesday, Dec. 15, 9 a.m. to noon Central time

Microsoft Copilot has evolved significantly over the past year, offering new opportunities for professionals to save time, improve productivity and incorporate artificial intelligence into their everyday work.

This three-hour interactive workshop will help participants better understand Microsoft’s expanding AI ecosystem and develop practical skills for getting more value from Copilot.

Participants will leave with practical strategies for integrating AI into their daily responsibilities and making the most of Microsoft’s AI tools in 2027.

Register for the Microsoft Copilot Virtual Workshop

Chris Porter is the director of the artificial intelligence program at Drake University and an associate professor of computer science. Chris Snider is a professor in Drake’s School of Journalism and Mass Communication.

Together, they founded Innovation Profs, an AI education and consulting company that helps individuals and organizations understand, adopt and effectively use generative AI tools through workshops, presentations and customized training.

Porter and Snider also publish a free weekly email newsletter covering developments in artificial intelligence.
